List every analysis GeneFox can perform, as the operation id, display name, summary and data scope...

gf_list_operations.Rd

List every analysis GeneFox can perform, as the operation id, display name, summary and data scope (imported/public_dataset). Instant.

Usage

gf_list_operations(
    session,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the list_operations tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/list-operations-result-v1.schema.json.

See also

gf_scientific_tools, gf_tools, gf_call
